    Custom Toolbar

    Custom Toolbar is a modular Editor extension that puts frequently used project controls on Unity's main toolbar.

    Features

    • Toggle Enter Play Mode Options without opening Project Settings.
    • Open the first enabled scene in Build Settings.
    • Select a scene from configured project folders.
    • Adjust and reset Time.timeScale.
    • Toggle the FMOD Debug Overlay when FMOD for Unity is installed.
    • Select the active locale when Unity Localization is installed.

    Custom Toolbar supports Unity 2022.3 LTS through Unity 6. Unity 6.3 and newer use the official Main Toolbar API; earlier supported versions use the package's legacy toolbar host.

    Start with Requirements, then follow Installation and Getting started. To add a project-specific control, see Create a custom module.
